title: The Warding Primer
summary: A first primer in drawing qi into a thin ward over the body and over a friend and in feeling a blow before it lands.

title: A Workbook of Plain Shielding
summary: A workbook of narrow shells and rolling covers that teaches a student to guard one side while the other stays free to move.

title: The Handbook of Guarded Breath
summary: A handbook that ties the ward to the breath so that each out-breath tightens it and each in-breath lets it settle.

title: A Drill-Book for Standing Between
summary: A drill-book of small steps and wards that put the student on the near side of anyone in danger.

title: The Treatise on Even Barriers
summary: A treatise on laying a barrier of even thickness so that no spot of it is weaker than another.

title: A Primer of Level Screening
summary: A primer in flat wards held at a set angle that turn a strike aside instead of stopping it.

title: The First Shielding Workbook
summary: A workbook for a student's first full season of shielding that builds from one ward to a pair held together.

title: The Canon of the Settled Stance
summary: A short canon that roots the ward in the stance so the body gives the barrier its weight.

title: A Handbook of Soft Covering
summary: A handbook of cushioning wards that take the sting from a blow and from a thrown or dropped thing.

title: A Primer of Simple Guarding
summary: A last primer of the plainest guards that ends the Basic course and shows how the single ward grows into a layered one.
